## 1. Priority Tasks (Deadlines) | # | Item | Deadline | Action | |---|------|----------|--------| | 1 | **Rewrite‑vs‑Append Ablation** – run *MemGPT*‑based naive append baseline + periodic consolidation control to isolate rewrite effect | **Day 19** (ICLR rebuttal) | • Draft experiment plan & schedule now.
• Draft reply: “We will augment our experiments with a MemGPT-based append baseline to isolate rewrite contributions.” | | 2 | **Weekly Lab Meeting** – set to Wednesdays at 11 h (currently no Thursday slot) | **Next meeting** | • Confirm room and agenda. | | 3 | **GPU Allocation** – use 2400 H100 h for May | **Week 1** – set up jobs | • Estimate compute per run; schedule sweep within quota. | | 4 | **Co‑author Workshop Paper** – Maya
No rush, but schedule 30 min sync during lab | – | • Reserve 30 min on Thursday (14:00, room 311) if possible. | > **Note:** The Thursday 14:00 slot was dropped; Wednesday 11:00 now the sole weekly meeting. ## 2. Execution & Resources * **Rebuttal Ablation** * Use confirmed insight: *MemGPT’s virtual context paging* as the naive‑append baseline (conf 0.78). * Add **periodic consolidation** (compression‑based) as a control; expected to lower interference and free GPU budget (~30 % less per run). * Target: 8‑12 experiment runs, finish **Day 15** for data review. * **GPU Plan** * 2400 H100 h covers: * 6× rewrite‑vs‑append sweep (≈200 h each) * 2× consolidation‑only control (≈150 h each) * 1× safety buffer. * **Lab Meeting Coordination** * Draft agenda: “Progress on ablation sweep, GPU status, workshop draft.” * Invite Maya for 30 min checkpoint. ## 3. Overnight Idea > **Overnight idea:** Apply MemGPT’s paging to store *only* the most recent 40 facts (the point where accuracy drops) and perform periodic compression on the archive. This combined mechanism should keep accuracy high even at larger store sizes and serve as a strong baseline for the ablation. --- **Next steps:** * Send the experiment plan to your advisor by EOD Day 10. * Mark meeting agenda in calendar. * Monitor GPU usage daily.
